title: security sign-off record
description: Machine-checkable security sign-off record. A security-gate module reads this to decide whether a sensitive ticket is approved. Integrity of WHO may create the record is the activation half (CODEOWNERS + branch protection) and is out of this module's scope; this schema is the machine-checkable content half.

ticket_id.description: MUST equal the gated ticket id.

verdict.description: Only APPROVED with conditions_status all-closed resolves to allow.

sensitivity_flags_covered.description: MUST be a superset of the ticket's derived+declared flags (F-3).

reviewed_artifact.description: Content-addresses what was reviewed; each sensitive file must be bound so a post-review change invalidates the sign-off (F-9).

reviewer.description: Integrity comes from CODEOWNERS (F-2, activation), not this field's contents.
